verdict: Lead volume and organic visibility both dropped — here is what is being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, paid channels tracked 6 leads at a cost of $270.71 each, and that cost per lead rose another 8% over the most recent 7 days while lead volume fell 33% — a trend that needs to reverse. Google Ads spend dropped 42% week over week, pulling down to roughly $14 per day in the last few days versus $58 per day the week prior; this appears to be an unintended throttle and is being corrected now. Your "Quality HVAC by Fibid" Google Business Profile generated 195 impressions this period but zero calls, and overall Google Business Profile actions fell 81% in the last 7 days — the profile is being reviewed to identify and clear whatever is suppressing call conversions. On the CRM side, your system recorded 522 contacts created and 40 won opportunities this period, which does not reconcile with the 6 paid-tracked leads; attribution is being audited so both numbers reflect reality going forward. Heating campaign creative and Google and Meta campaigns are scheduled to go live October 1, which should restore and grow volume as the season opens.

highlights.phrase: paid leads tracked in the last 28 days, with cost per lead at $270.71
drop in Google Ads spend over the last 7 days, not an intentional reduction
calls from the Quality HVAC by Fibid profile despite 195 impressions this period

watch_item.issue: Google Ads spend throttled sharply and unpredictably over the last three days, reducing lead opportunities mid-period.
watch_item.fix: Spend pacing is being reviewed and corrected this week to restore daily delivery ahead of the October heating campaign launch.
